author: Zephyr III
title: A2C TD(0) — vlc=0.60 — α=0.33, head=64 — scan-correct RNN (no adv-norm)
abstract: TD(0) A2C using current-network values with scan-correct RNN rollout. Identical to the 92.6 baseline but with value_loss_coef=0.60. Complements vlc=0.50 to bracket the 0.55 baseline.
